While you drag, the thumb follows the pointer exactly. When the value jumps, from a press on the track, a key or a new controlled value, the thumb and fill glide there in 180ms instead of teleporting.
With `orientation="vertical"` the slider fills its parent's height, and Up raises the value.
`onValueChange` fires on every move and `onValueCommitted` once on release, which is the moment to save. Setting the value from outside glides too.
`showValue` shows the formatted value above the thumb while it is dragged or focused from the keyboard. Use it instead of a label row, since the bubble rises into the space above the track.
